Coefficient-product limits prove strict-contraction exponential mean and jump rarity; at q=1 the hyperbolic-polynomial reduction proves the finite Brownian-scale mean. The independent finite-difference and exact-arithmetic checker passed 250 diagnostics. All parameters quantified, with no extrapolation from finite tests.

value.rationale: First entry into a target region, not exact equality, is the natural detection rule when a reset teleports a searcher. For negative position multipliers it opens a physically real competing jump-capture channel. The theorem evaluates both the mean and its channel probability at every positive rate and obtains a sharp singular contrast between contracting reflection and exact reflection: the former mean diverges exponentially at high rates while the latter tends to L^2/(2D), with a nonzero jump-capture probability. This is a structural, global qualitative classification, not a tiny numerical correction or routine reformulation.
